case_number: 2023 INSC 649; SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 5263 OF 2023

parties.petitioner: M/s Universal Sompo General Insurance Co. Ltd.

summary: Insurance claim dispute; fire/burglary policies for Rs.50 lakh; theft at insured premises; insurer repudiated theft claim; SCDRC ordered joint liability of insurer & bank; NCDRC dismissed appeal; availability of direct Supreme Court appeal under Consumer Protection Act, 1986 s.23; appellate vs original jurisdiction distinction; special leave under Article 136; limitation on appeals against appellate orders of NCDRC.
final_judgment: Petition dismissed; no further appeal allowed against NCDRC appellate orders; recourse to writ/supervisory jurisdiction under Art.226/227.
